flows:
Navigate to https://esim.holafly.com/ then Use only keyboard input.
Use Tab or Shift+Tab to move focus and Enter or Space to activate the exact control.
Move in whichever direction is shorter.
Group repeated Tab presses if supported, checking focus frequently.
Do not click, focus elements directly, use JavaScript, or navigate directly to the destination.
Complete the registered journey in order and check each requested outcome.
Use the declared arrow keys and Escape as needed.
Do not use a substitute destination or control.
If a required control is missing, invisible, or cannot be reached, report the task as failed.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, send or submit anything, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Focus “Countries”, move once with ArrowRight, activate “Regions” and read its panel.

verdict.root_cause: Keyboard focus was still moving through the page’s search controls rather than being on Countries. ArrowRight was therefore sent to the wrong focused control.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the outcome by sending Tab and ArrowRight without verifying that Countries had actually received focus. The screenshots show focus on the travel field and then the Search plan button during the recorded keyboard navigation, not a confirmed focus state on Countries. There is no evidence that the site ignored ArrowRight while Countries was correctly focused.
verdict.bug_title: ArrowRight sent before Countries had focus
verdict.suggestion: Restart the keyboard path, check focus after each Tab near the destination tabs, and send ArrowRight only once Countries has a visible focus outline.
